text:
sam (sales): Quick sync: MNFRx needs a Dedicated 4-week POC with SAML (Okta), SCIM group filtering (engineering + ops), RBAC mapping to tenant_admin, and domain verification. Confirming requirements before we send the quote.

sasha (customer): Correct. Also need KMS-managed keys, SOC2 report, and completed security questionnaire by EOW. We'll provide Okta metadata and a SCIM service account.

ana (solutions): We're able to do Dedicated POC. I'll draft the quote and add a contract addendum for Dedicated evaluation. Pricing options: 1) Dedicated POC flat-rate (reserved GPUs) — estimated $22k for 4 weeks; 2) Hosted metered test — estimate depends on tokens but likely cheaper. I'll DM the detailed matrix.

devon (eng): Engineering notes for onboarding:
- SCIM: supports full and delta syncs, group filter via query param: /Groups?filter=displayName eq "engineering"
- SCIM rate limit: 10 req/s during POC (we can bump with notice)
- SCIM supports custom attributes and mapping to internal roles
- SAML: we need the IdP SAML metadata XML or ACS URL + SP Entity ID
- Domain proofing: we support TXT record (_redwood_mnfrx=abc123) or admin email verification (admin@mnfrx.com).

mike (security): For Dedicated/Private with KMS keys, we'll need a data handling addendum. Also attaching SOC2 summary + penetration test report to the portal. @sasha: will there be any raw PII? If yes we need additional controls.

sasha (customer): No raw PII, only user emails + hashed ids. We'll do DNS TXT for domain verification. Sending Okta metadata and SCIM token tonight.

sam (sales): Action list: 1) Sasha to share Okta metadata + SCIM token and group list. 2) Ana to send POC quote and PO template. 3) Devon to prepare SCIM test endpoints and runbook. 4) Mike to upload SOC2/pen test and start questionnaire.

ana (solutions): I'll include a short-runbook appendix in the quote showing SCIM steps and SAML config snippet. Also adding cancellation terms for the POC.

devon (eng): Example SCIM provisioning curl for initial test (we'll provide base URL via PM):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://scim.rw.example.com/v2/Users" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"userName":"alicia@mnfrx.com","name":{"givenName":"Alicia","familyName":"Doe"}}'
```

mike (security): sec-bot, create ticket: MNFRx-POC-SecQuestionnaire. I'll fill answers and link controls.

sec-bot: Ticket created MNFRx-POC-SecQuestionnaire. Status: Open. Owner: mike (security). Link: https://redwood-secure.example.com/tickets/MNFRx-POC-1

sasha (customer): Thanks team. We'll aim to complete DNS TXT today and send Okta metadata after internal review. One more Q: do you support SCIM deprovisioning on group removal?

devon (eng): Yes, we send 204 on delete and deprovision users by removing entitlements. Will include example mapping rules in runbook.

sam (sales): Scheduling kickoff tomorrow 10am PT with eng + security + customer. Ping me if anything changes.

ana (solutions): Added to calendar.

mike (security): I'll have the SOC2 packet and a first pass on the questionnaire by the meeting.

sasha (customer): See you tomorrow, thanks!
